=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md:55 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The moved §25.C text carries the retired token `send_later` (also in workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md:55), and this PR places it inside a scanned directory.
  WHY: tests/test_no_session_automation.py:23 scans `.claude` and `workflow-templates`, and the check run on head c797b81e68f706612926169fb35e727c24478503 (run 40754041549) fails with these hits, which keeps `lint` red. tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py:284 requires the copies to be byte-identical, so reword both identically and edit CLAUDE.md:1231 to match.
- workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md:55 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The same banned token is in the template half of the pair; both copies must be edited together (tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py:284).
  WHY: The identical hit keeps the tests-hooks-and-orchestrator job and the lint aggregate red until both copies are reworded.
- changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md:4 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "copied verbatim, so no rule was dropped" claim is true only while the reference files hold the pre-PR text unchanged. The `send_later` fix and the owed §23.C sentence both edit that text.
  WHY: scripts/assemble_changelog.py publishes the fragment to CHANGELOG.md and to consumer repos. Change "copied verbatim" to "moved with minimal edits", and fix the PR description's "word for word" too.
- changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md:8 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The last autofix run changed this cell to "about 65,900 bytes", while the PR description says "about 65,500 bytes".
  WHY: The release note and the release PR state the headline metric differently; reconcile both against the real byte count.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:144 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The PR creates the `.claude/docs/**` live-copy path class, which allowed() excludes from the review editor's writable set, and PAIRED_LIVE_COPIES (lines 71-73) does not cover it.
  WHY: The repository's autofix loop cannot write the live half of the byte-identical pair, which is why the send_later blocker survived more than ten rounds. The fix needs an interactive session or the implement phase with an exact `files_touched` entry.

TASK_GAP:
- Requirement: PR description Summary item 1: "That go counts as the §23.C approval for opening issues or dispatching." agents.d/8250-claude-md-reference-docs.md:10-11: "When a rule in one of those sections changes, edit both the `CLAUDE.md` summary and the reference file." .claude/docs/s23-github-access.md:3-5: "Both are binding; where this file adds detail, follow it."
  Expected change site: The "Command-invoked dispatches are already approved" paragraph in .claude/docs/s23-github-access.md and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md (the paragraph ends at line 135 in both).
  Evidence of absence: CLAUDE.md:988-990 carries the §31 sentence, but grep for "§31" in both s23 reference copies returns no match and both paragraphs still end at "your own judgement." (line 135). No hunk in the PR diff or last-run diff adds it.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

NOTES: The copilot-pull-request-reviewer failure (`custom_instructions_too_large`, HTTP 422) is not attributable to this diff. The dominant input is agents.md, which this PR does not touch.
